options.name: SelectTypeParameters
options.description: Partition-specific resource allocation type

options.name: allocNodes
options.description: Comma separated list of nodes from which users can submit jobs in the partition

options.name: allowAccounts
options.description: Specify accounts which are allowed to run jobs

options.name: allowGroups
options.description: Specify user groups which are allowed to run jobs

options.name: allowQos
options.description: Specify qos which are allowed to run jobs

options.name: alternate
options.description: Partition name of alternate partition to be used if the state of this partition is DRAIN or INACTIVE

options.name: cloneFrom
options.description: The id or name of the entity that the new entity will be cloned from.  (take effect only at entity creation)

options.name: cpuBind
options.description: How tasks are bound to allocated CPUs

options.name: defCpuPerGPU
options.description: Default count of CPUs allocated per allocated GPU

options.name: defMemPerCPU
options.description: Default real memory size available per allocated CPU in MegaBytes

options.name: defMemPerGPU
options.description: Default  real  memory  size  available  per  allocated GPU in megabytes

options.name: defMemPerNode
options.description: Default real memory size available per allocated node in MegaBytes

options.name: defaultQueue
options.description: Set this as the default queue

options.name: defaultTime
options.description: Default job runtime

options.name: denyAccounts
options.description: Specify accounts which are denied to run jobs

options.name: denyQos
options.description: Specify qos which are denied to run jobs

options.name: disableRoot
options.description: Do not allow root to run jobs

options.name: exclusiveUser
options.description: If set to YES then nodes will be exclusively allocated to users

options.name: graceTime
options.description: Specifies, in units of seconds, the preemption grace time to be extended to a job which has been selected for preemption

options.name: hidden
options.description: Hide from all

options.name: lln
options.description: Schedule resources to jobs on the least loaded nodes

options.name: maxCPUsPerNode
options.description: Maximum number of CPUs on any node available to all jobs from this partition

options.name: maxMemPerCPU
options.description: Maximum real memory size available per allocated CPU in MegaBytes

options.name: maxMemPerNode
options.description: Maximum real memory size available per allocated node in MegaBytes

options.name: maxNodes
options.description: Maximal nodes one job can use

options.name: maxTime
options.description: Maximal job runtime

options.name: minNodes
options.description: Minimal nodes one job has to use

options.name: name
options.description: Name of queue

options.name: options
options.description: Additional parameters that will be passed to the WLM queue configuration

options.name: ordering
options.description: Positioning of the jobqueue. Smaller values go first in the configuration file.

options.name: overSubscribe
options.description: Controls the ability of the partition to execute more than one job at a time on each resource

options.name: preemptMode
options.description: Mechanism used to preempt jobs from this partition

options.name: priorityJobFactor
options.description: Partition factor used by priority/multifactor plugin in calculating job priority

options.name: priorityTier
options.description: Jobs submitted to a partition with a higher priority tier value will be dispatched before pending jobs in partition with lower priority tier value

options.name: qos
options.description: Used to extend the limits available to a QOS on a partition

options.name: reqResv
options.description: Specifies users of this partition are required to designate a reservation when submitting a job

options.name: rootOnly
options.description: Only allow root to run jobs

options.name: state
options.description: The state the resource should have

options.name: tresBillingWeights
options.description: Billing weights of each TRES type that will be used in calculating the usage of a job

options.name: wlmCluster
options.description: WlmCluster to which this node belongs
